title: Seoul Fashion Week 2026: Dates, Shows & How to Attend
description: Seoul Fashion Week has become Asia's most exciting fashion event. Here's how to experience it — shows, after-parties, and street style.
content:
Seoul Fashion Week (서울패션위크) takes place twice yearly — March/April and October — and has grown from a regional showcase into one of Asia's most internationally attended fashion events. Here's how to make the most of it.

2026 Dates

  • Spring/Summer Season: March 16-21, 2026
  • Fall/Winter Season: October 13-18, 2026

Both seasons are held primarily at Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP), the architecturally spectacular Zaha Hadid-designed building in central Seoul.

Attending Shows

Official runway shows require industry credentials or invitations. However:

  • Some designers offer limited public tickets through their brand websites
  • The DDP exterior and plaza become free public fashion spectacles during the week
  • Several off-schedule shows by emerging designers are open to enthusiastic walk-ins

Korean Designers to Watch

  • Blindness — Dark, conceptual, internationally collected
  • Rokh — South Korean designer based in Paris, now also showing in Seoul
  • Museum of Peace — Streetwear with historical Korean imagery
  • Minjukim — Exuberant, maximalist, frequently celebrity-worn
💡 Street Style Tip: The street style photography outside DDP during fashion week is world-class. Arrive 1-2 hours before any show's scheduled start time for the best people-watching.

The After-Party Scene

Fashion week brings Seoul's nightlife to a fever pitch. Itaewon and Hannam-dong clubs see major fashion events nightly. Check brand Instagram stories for event announcements.
